1. (Currently amended) A method for treating an ocular condition, the method comprising: administering to the interior of an eye a composition comprising a therapeutically effective amount of a macromolecular anti-angiogenic component (MAAC) to a mammal suffering from an ocular condition, wherein the composition also comprises a viscosity inducing component in an amount effective to increase the viscosity of the composition to a viscosity at 25°C of __at least 10 cps and not more than about 300,000 cps__ at a shear rate of about 0.1/second, wherein said viscosity inducing component is injectable into the vitreous of a mammalian eye without permanently diminishing visual acuity, and wherein __said ocular condition is characterized by pathological angiogenesis__.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein said composition comprises a solution.

3. (Original) The method of claim 1 wherein said composition comprises a gel.

4. (Original) The method of claim 1 wherein said composition comprises a suspension.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein __the MAAC comprises a direct or indirect inhibitor of a vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) activity__.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 5 wherein the MAAC comprises __a polypeptide__.

7. (Original) The method of claim 6 wherein said MAAC comprises a nucleic acid.

8. (Original) The method of claim 7 wherein said nucleic acid comprises a therapeutic agent selected from the group consisting of an aptamer, an RNAi, a ribozyme, and an antisense oligonucleotide.

9. (Original) The method of claim 8 wherein said MAAC comprises a therapeutic agent selected from the group consisting of siRNA Z, pegaptanib, and Cand5.

10. 11. (Original) The method of claim 10 wherein said nucleic acid has a nucleotide sequence having at least 90% identity to a nucleotide sequence selected from said group.

12. (Original) The method of claim 11 wherein said nucleic acid has a nucleotide sequence having at least 95% identity to a nucleotide sequence selected from said group.

13. (Original) The method of claim 11 wherein said nucleic acid has at least 95% identity to a nucleotide sequence selected from said group.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein said MAAC comprises __an angiogenesis inhibitor polypeptide__.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 14 wherein said polypeptide is selected from the group consisting of __an angiogenesis inhibitor and a receptor inhibitor__.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 14 wherein said polypeptide comprises __bevacizumab__.

20. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein said viscosity inducing component comprises __a hyaluronic acid__.
